name: prompt-meter
description: Shows how each prompt changes the context and how many tokens the turn used

CONTEXT_WINDOW.title: Context window size
CONTEXT_WINDOW.description: Tokens in your model's context window, used for the % full figure. 1000000 for 1M-context models, 200000 otherwise.

SHOW_ON_SUBMIT.title: Show token split on submit
SHOW_ON_SUBMIT.description: When you send a prompt, show how it splits into tokens and how it moves the context window.

SHOW_AFTER_TURN.title: Show turn report when Claude finishes
SHOW_AFTER_TURN.description: When Claude finishes answering, show how the turn moved the context and how many input and output tokens it used.

MAX_TOKENS_SHOWN.title: Tokens shown in the split
MAX_TOKENS_SHOWN.description: How many tokens of your prompt to show split up before summarizing the rest.

COMMAND.title: Browser command
COMMAND.description: Word that opens the in-session prompt browser: <word>, <word> <number>, <word> last, <word> help.
